props.text:
The Training Grounds
Falcon trains every new arrival here: blade, bow and light.
East: the town.

Falcon's Landing
West: the Training Grounds.
Up the mountain path: the lookout.
South: the meadow cottages.

North Reach: CLOSED.
By Falcon's order, nobody goes north until their training is done.

East Fields: CLOSED.
Wild ground past the fence. Falcon's order.

The west pass: CLOSED.
Loose rock. Turn back.

LANDING NOTICES

- New arrivals: report to Falcon in town. Don't wander off the edge.
- Training Grounds open to all. Please return the practice swords.
- Mice in the meadow again. Rats in the warren. Pigs in the hollow. Falcon says they're good practice.
- LOST: one letter, sealed, Archive wax. Last seen blowing south. Reward from Maelis.
- The north road is closed by order of the Warden. Rockfalls.
- Supplies at Landing Supply, by the east gate.

THE GILDED COG
Rooms, stew and a warm hearth.
No dancing on the tables. (We mean it this time.)

PENWICK'S BOOKS
New, used and rare.
The Great Benefactor: always in stock.

BRASS & BARREL PROVISIONS
Rope, lamp-oil, ley-shards, bread, boots.
If we don't have it, you don't need it.

THE TRICODE RESERVE
Your coin, kept safe beneath three ley lines.
Deposits and withdrawals at the counter.

ADVENTURERS' GUILD of TRICODE
Work for blades, bows and spells.
Ask inside. Wipe your boots.

BRASSWICK LEY-WORKS
Lamps lit, pumps primed, clocks wound.
Do NOT touch the blue ones.

SKYPORT
Barges to the Landing and beyond, weather and wind allowing.
Cargo inspected by order of the Hall.

ANVILSONG FORGE
Blades, tools and hinges.
Apprentices welcome. Eyebrows not guaranteed.

THREAD & TIMBER
Leather, cloth, wood and wire.
Mend it, make it, or learn how.

North: the Market, the Hall
East: the Cathedral, the Skyport
South: the Forge, the Workshops
West: the Docks

Tricode City: the West Gate
The Docks: down the bank
